name: ai-coach-core
description: The engine every AI Coach plugin runs on. Owns the session brief, the memory database, the secrets guard, and every hook — so the coach plugins above it ship skills and nothing else.

brief_chars.title: Session brief size (chars)
brief_chars.description: Ceiling on the memory injected at session start. Storage is unbounded and ranking happens before the cap, so raising this surfaces more, it does not change what wins.

coach.title: Coaching
coach.description: The coach line in the session brief, and one-line hints on vague prompts. Shown to you only — nothing is injected into the model's context. Display only: turning this off does not stop failures being recorded (see Record failures).

corrections.title: Record failures
corrections.description: When a failure notification surfaces, record that it happened — the signal word, the message, and what was being asked. This is the evidence /prompt-coach:prompt-stats measures prompt habits against. No model call, and the prompt text is never stored.

learn.title: Session-end learning
learn.description: One Haiku call per session distils a summary and 0-3 durable learnings. Stored marked as distilled, never passed off as something you wrote. Requires `claude` on PATH.

plan_review.title: Plan-mode prompt review
plan_review.description: In plan mode only: one Haiku call scores the prompt and suggests a rewrite. Backs off for an hour after a failure.

guard.title: Secrets guard
guard.description: Blocks tool calls carrying real credentials and asks before secret-ish payloads or credential-file reads. Fails open, always logged.

spotlight.title: Injection check on fetched content
spotlight.description: Scans WebFetch/WebSearch results and out-of-repo file reads for prompt-injection markers, and reminds the model to treat matches as data. Warn-only, zero LLM calls, fails open.

partners.title: Partner tools note
partners.description: A one-time session note suggesting /harness-coach:partners — a curated list of tools that pair well with Claude Code. Disappears after the first run; nothing ever installs without your pick.

seed_auto.title: Keep the team seed current
seed_auto.description: Refresh .ai-coach/team-seed.jsonl on /compact, /clear and after each commit. Only ever touches a seed that already exists; never stages or commits.

default_trust.title: Trust for teammates you have not rated
default_trust.description: full: imported memories rank like your own. workspace: held privately with capped confidence until you raise them. Per-teammate trust stays on this machine.
